1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Aussie-themed card game with an original identity and a blend of flip-side and high-penalty gameplay.
- Include pass-and-play, AI opponents, online play, tournaments, leaderboards, touchscreen controls, and music.

## Requirements
- User requested: “full on pass and play and against ai opponents or online all up as well and tournaments and leaderboards all up as well and full touch screen controls and music”.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note limitations at completion.

## Decisions
- Created **Last One Out — Aussie Card Club**, using original branding and Aussie-themed names.
- Combined local AI/pass-and-play, two-sided Storm & Scrub cards, stackable penalties, and an optional 25-card bust rule.
- Clearly label online multiplayer and shared leaderboards as not connected in this build.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive home, setup, game, tournament, leaderboard, and field-guide screens.
- Implemented playable local card rounds against AI or pass-and-play, card matching, wild colour selection, penalties, flipping, bust-outs, stats saved to localStorage, and synthesized background audio.
- `node --check game.js` and `node --check game-extra.js` passed.
- Browser smoke test loaded the home/setup/game screens without console errors after fixing a `top` global naming conflict; selected a legal card during testing.

### Active
- Finish gameplay smoke testing, fix any issues, and capture/read a current JPEG screenshot.
- Review/fix game flow edge cases and polish as needed.

### Blocked
- Actual online multiplayer, shared/global leaderboards, and full tournament mode are not implemented; current tournament board is a local qualifier teaser.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing from the current state (player selected a card); play it and exercise draw/end-turn, AI turn, and pass-and-play flows.
2. Check any gameplay bugs, capture a small JPEG screenshot, and inspect it.
3. Summarize implementation and clearly note unavailable online/shared tournament features.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: App shell and loaded styles/scripts.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and game layout.
- `game.js`: Home/setup/game rendering and deck/game initialization.
- `game-extra.js`: Gameplay actions, AI, stats, navigation screens, music.
- `README.md`: Existing project landing page.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local preview server was started on port `3002`; browser is open at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The latest browser state is an active local-AI game with a playable card selected; “PLAY CARD” is available.

## Last One Out — Aussie Card Club

A responsive, browser-playable card game featuring local AI matches, pass-and-play, Storm & Scrub two-sided decks, stackable penalties, optional bust rules, synthesized background audio, local stats, and a three-round local tournament. Player stats and leaderboard data are stored in the browser.

Online multiplayer and shared/global leaderboards require a backend and are not connected in this build. The local tournament and leaderboard are device-only.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Aussie-themed card game with an original identity, supporting local play modes and club features.

## Requirements
- User requested: “full on pass and play and against ai opponents or online all up as well and tournaments and leaderboards all up as well and full touch screen controls and music”.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note limitations at completion.

## Decisions
- Created **Last One Out — Aussie Card Club**, with Storm & Scrub two-sided cards, stackable penalties, and an optional 25-card bust rule.
- Implemented a three-round local tournament and device-local leaderboard; online multiplayer and shared leaderboards remain disconnected.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built responsive home, setup, game, tournament, leaderboard, and field-guide screens.
- Implemented local AI and pass-and-play, card matching, wild colour selection, penalties, flips, bust-outs, local stats, and synthesized background audio.
- Added a playable three-round Gumtree Gauntlet tournament.
- Fixed wild-card chosen-colour matching, empty-deck turn handling, music shutdown, and a false-callout bust edge case.
- Documented features and online limitations in `README.md`.
- Passed JavaScript syntax checks, `git diff --check`, desktop/mobile browser smoke tests, AI/pass-and-play/tournament flows, and saw no browser console errors. Mobile viewport had no horizontal overflow.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- Online multiplayer and cross-device/shared leaderboards are not connected; they require a backend.

## Next Move
1. Summarize the implementation and clearly note that online play and global/shared leaderboards are unavailable in this build.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: App shell and loaded styles/scripts.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and game layout.
- `game.js`: Home/setup/game rendering and game initialization.
- `game-extra.js`: Gameplay actions, AI, tournament, stats, navigation, and music.
- `README.md`: Project features and limitations.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files other than `README.md` appear as untracked.
- Local preview server is available at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Smoke-test screenshots were saved outside the project at `/tmp/opencode/last-one-out.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/tournament-result.jpg`.

content.text:
Built **Last One Out — Aussie Card Club**, a playable Aussie-themed card game with:

- Pass-and-play and AI opponents
- Storm & Scrub cards, stackable penalties, wild-colour choices, and an optional bust rule
- A three-round Gumtree Gauntlet tournament
- Device-local stats and leaderboard
- Touch-friendly responsive controls, synthesized background music, and a field guide

**Limitation:** Online multiplayer and shared, cross-device leaderboards aren’t connected; they require a backend. The local game flows and mobile layout were smoke-tested, with no browser console errors reported.

Key files: `game.js`, `game-extra.js`, `style.css`, and `README.md`. The changes are uncommitted.
